title: Drift Wood #6 · the Thanksgiving issue
logline: What are you thankful for. Wood has a list. Gully has a shorter one.

panels.composition: The newsroom. CHLOE with a clipboard, doing the Thanksgiving-issue survey. GULLY at the back table.

balloons.text: Survey. One thing you're thankful for. Gully.

image.prompt: a teenage girl with a clipboard surveying a boy in a backwards cap at a table in a school newsroom, a hand-lettered poster on the wall

balloons.text: The tension between the individual and the provincial. The fog. Truffaut. The fact that no one here reads, which leaves the field open—

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat standing and holding up one finger mid-list, a girl with a clipboard waiting
close-up of a girl writing one word on a clipboard survey form

panels.composition: The survey results, pasted up: a column of names and one word each. GULLY: maple bars. WOOD: fog. CHLOE: —. Her line is blank.
panels.caption: THANKFUL FOR — THE TIMBERLINE ASKS

image.prompt: a pasted-up newspaper column of student names with one word beside each, one line left blank, xerox grain
image.notes: The lettering here is the point; letter it after if the generator garbles: GULLIVER — maple bars / FINCH — fog / STERLING — (blank).

notes: Chloe's blank line. The strip never explains it; the reader decides she's thankful for nothing here, or for something she won't print.
